links.text: Make the Right Call 911 is only for emergencies. To report police non-emergencies or request city services and information, call 311.
911 Performance Dashboard The 911 Performance Dashboard provides performance data on 911 call handling, dispatching, staffing, and more. The dashboard will be updated weekly.
Become a 911 Professional! We're hiring! Apply today and become a 911 Professional.
OUC Junior Academy The OUC is proud to announce the launch of its Junior Academy. The free, five-week, program exposes high school students to several vital public service career opportunities.
911 Communications Familiarize your household with tips to ensure that 9-1-1 call takers can process your emergency calls efficiently.

311 - The Citywide Call Center Dial 311, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, to request scheduled services such as trash removal, repair of potholes, bulk pickups and recycling. To reach 311 from outside the city dial (202) 737-4404.
